questions.stem: On a distance-time graph, a curved line that gets steeper over time indicates the object is:
questions.explanation: A curve that gets steeper means the gradient (speed) is increasing over time, which means the object is accelerating.

questions.stem: An object travels 120 m in 40 seconds at constant speed. What is the gradient of its distance-time graph?
questions.explanation: Gradient = distance / time = 120 / 40 = 3 m/s. This is also the constant speed of the object.
